The Story

Built on a
Lifetime of Bikes.

Clay Schwarck has spent 20 years riding, wrenching, racing, and building relationships in the cycling industry. From his first hand-built Ibis Alibi to running his own Breckenridge shop — every year added another layer of expertise.

"It's this passion that has led me to grow into a small 'Neighborhood Bike' shop and build one-on-one relationships with my clients."

Trained by Shimano, Fox, RockShox, SRAM, DT Swiss, and more — Clay brings workshop-level knowledge to every tune, fit, and build.

— Clay Schwarck, Owner
